title: Missing Number
prompt: A survey exports unique IDs from 0 through n but one ID is missing. Write a function that returns the missing number.

explanation.beginner:
Example: missingNumber([3,0,1]) produces 2. The result must follow this precise rule: A survey exports unique IDs from 0 through n but one ID is missing. Write a function that returns the missing number. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “finds missing zero”: input [[1,2,3]] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
